text:
asyncapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Bank Channel Events
  version: 0.2.0
  description: Durable channel events; consumers must be inbox-idempotent.
defaultContentType: application/json
channels:
  transferStatusChanged:
    address: bank.transfer.status.changed
    messages:
      transferStatusChanged:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/TransferStatusChanged'
  transferReversed:
    address: bank.transfer.reversed
    messages:
      transferReversed:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/TransferReversed'
  loanStatusChanged:
    address: bank.loan.status.changed
    messages:
      loanStatusChanged:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/LoanStatusChanged'
  clearingCallbackReceived:
    address: bank.clearing.callback.received
    messages:
      clearingCallbackReceived:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/ClearingCallbackReceived'
  eodCompleted:
    address: bank.eod.completed
    messages:
      eodCompleted:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/EodCompleted'
operations:
  publishTransferStatusChanged:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: '#/channels/transferStatusChanged' }
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/transferStatusChanged/messages/transferStatusChanged'
  publishTransferReversed:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: '#/channels/transferReversed' }
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/transferReversed/messages/transferReversed'
  publishLoanStatusChanged:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: '#/channels/loanStatusChanged' }
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/loanStatusChanged/messages/loanStatusChanged'
  publishClearingCallbackReceived:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: '#/channels/clearingCallbackReceived' }
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/clearingCallbackReceived/messages/clearingCallbackReceived'
  publishEodCompleted:
    act

pages:
  # ===== Customer Portal (15 pages) =====
  - pageId: customer.login
    routePattern: /login
    readyMarker:
      testId: login-title
    elements:
      username:
        testId: login-username
        role: textbox
        label: 用户名
      password:
        testId: login-password
        role: textbox
        label: 密码
        sensitive: true
      submit:
        testId: login-submit
        role: button
        name: 登录
      sso:
        testId: login-sso
        role: button
      error:
        testId: login-error

  - pageId: customer.dashboard
    routePattern: /dashboard
    readyMarker:
      testId: dashboard-welcome
    elements:
      refresh:
        testId: dashboard-refresh
        role: button
      logout:
        testId: dashboard-logout
        role: button
      accountCount:
        testId: dashboard-account-count
      totalBalance:
        testId: dashboard-total-balance
      activeAccounts:
        testId: dashboard-active-accounts
      error:
        testId: dashboard-error

  - pageId: customer.accounts
    routePattern: /accounts
    readyMarker:
      testId: account-list
    elements:
      transfer:
        testId: account-list-transfer
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: account-list-empty
      error:
        testId: account-list-error

- pageId: customer.account.detail
    routePattern: /accounts/:accountId
    readyMarker:
      testId: account-detail
    elements:
      back:
        testId: account-detail-back
        role: button
      balance:
        testId: account-detail-balance
      type:
        testId: account-detail-type
      status:
        testId: account-detail-status
      id:
        testId: account-detail-id
      maskedNumber:
        testId: account-detail-masked-number
      transactions:
        testId: account-detail-transactions
      noTransactions:
        testId: account-detail-no-transactions

  - pageId: customer.transfers
    routePattern: /transfers
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-list
    elements:
      new:
        testId: transfer-list-new
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: transfer-list-empty
      error:
        testId: transfer-list-error
      table:
        testId: transfer-list-table

  - pageId: customer.transfer.create
    routePattern: /transfers/new
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-form
    elements:
      sourceAccount:
        testId: transfer-source-account
        role: combobox
      beneficiary:
        testId: transfer-beneficiary
        role: combobox
      amount:
        testId: transfer-amount
        role: textbox
        label: 转账金额
      description:
        testId: transfer-description
        role: textbox
      confirm:
        testId: transfer-confirm
        role: button
        name: 确认转账
      cancel:
        testId: transfer-cancel
        role: button
      error:
        testId: transfer-error

- pageId: customer.transfer.result
    routePattern: /transfers/:paymentId
    readyMarker:
      testId: transfer-result
    elements:
      back:
        testId: transfer-result-back
        role: button
      paymentId:
        testId: transfer-result-payment-id
      status:
        testId: transfer-result-status
      amount:
        testId: transfer-result-amount
      fromAccount:
        testId: transfer-result-from-account
      toAccount:
        testId: transfer-result-to-account
      coreReference:
        testId: transfer-result-core-reference
      notFound:
        testId: transfer-result-not-found
      newTransfer:
        testId: transfer-result-new-transfer
        role: button
      dashboard:
        testId: transfer-result-dashboard
        role: button

  - pageId: customer.beneficiaries
    routePattern: /beneficiaries
    readyMarker:
      testId: beneficiary-list
    elements:
      newTransfer:
        testId: beneficiary-new-transfer
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: beneficiary-empty

  - pageId: customer.loans
    routePattern: /loans
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-list
    elements:
      apply:
        testId: loan-list-apply
        role: button
      empty:
        testId: loan-list-empty
      error:
        testId: loan-list-error
      table:
        testId: loan-list-table

- pageId: customer.loans.apply
    routePattern: /loans/apply
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-apply-form
    elements:
      amount:
        testId: loan-apply-amount
        role: spinbutton
      term:
        testId: loan-apply-term
        role: combobox
      purpose:
        testId: loan-apply-purpose
        role: textbox
      submit:
        testId: loan-apply-submit
        role: button
        name: 提交申请
      cancel:
        testId: loan-apply-cancel
        role: button
      error:
        testId: loan-apply-error

  - pageId: customer.loan.detail
    routePattern: /loans/:loanId
    readyMarker:
      testId: loan-detail
    elements:
      back:
        testId: loan-detail-back
        role: button
      principal:
        testId: loan-detail-principal
      outstanding:
        testId: loan-detail-outstanding
      term:
        testId: loan-detail-term
      rate:
        testId: loan-detail-rate
      id:
        testId: loan-detail-id
      product:
        testId: loan-detail-product
      status:
        testId: loan-detail-status
      error:
        testId: loan-detail-error

  - pageId: customer.documents
    routePattern: /documents
    readyMarker:
      testId: document-list
    elements:
      table:
        testId: document-list-table
      empty:
        testId: document-list-empty
      error:
        testId: document-list-error

  - pageId: customer.messages
    routePattern: /messages
    readyMarker:
      testId: message-list
    elements:
      empty:
        testId: message-list-empty
      error:
        testId: message-list-error
      items:
        testId: message-list-items

- pageId: customer.profile
    routePattern: /profile
    readyMarker:
      testId: profile-detail
    elements:
      customerId:
        testId: profile-customer-id
      displayName:
        testId: profile-name
      email:
        testId: profile-email
      phone:
        testId: profile-phone
      error:
        testId: profile-error
      empty:
        testId: profile-empty

  - pageId: customer.security
    routePattern: /security
    readyMarker:
      testId: security-settings
    elements:
      mfaEnabled:
        testId: security-mfa-enabled
      mfaDisabled:
        testId: security-mfa-disabled
      mfaMethod:
        testId: security-mfa-method
      passwordChange:
        testId: security-password-change
      loginNotifyOn:
        testId: security-login-notify-on
      loginNotifyOff:
        testId: security-login-notify-off
      lastLogin:
        testId: security-last-login
      error:
        testId: security-settings-error
      empty:
        testId: security-settings-empty

  # ===== Operations Console (12 pages) =====
  - pageId: operations.dashboard
    routePattern: /dashboard
    readyMarker:
      testId: dashboard-metrics
    elements:
      sidebar:
        testId: ops-sidebar
      navMenu:
        testId: ops-nav-menu
      pendingApprovals:
        testId: dashboard-pending-approvals
      clearingStatus:
        testId: dashboard-clearing-status
      reconStatus:
        testId: dashboard-recon-status
      systemHealth:
        testId: dashboard-system-health
      activePayments:
        testId: dashboard-active-payments
      failedPayments:
        testId: dashboard-failed-payments
      constraints:
        testId: dashboard-card-constraints

- pageId: operations.payments
    routePattern: /payments
    readyMarker:
      testId: payment-table
    elements:
      search:
        testId: payment-search
        role: textbox
      statusTag:
        testId: payment-status-tag
      amount:
        testId: payment-amount
      table:
        testId: payment-table

  - pageId: operations.payments.detail
    routePattern: /payments/:paymentId
    readyMarker:
      testId: state-history-timeline
    elements:
      back:
        testId: payment-detail-back-btn
        role: button
      summary:
        testId: payment-detail-summary
      status:
        testId: payment-detail-status
      amount:
        testId: payment-detail-amount
      stateHistory:
        testId: state-history-timeline
      outboxEvents:
        testId: outbox-event-type

  - pageId: operations.approvals
    routePattern: /approvals
    readyMarker:
      testId: approval-audit-trail
    elements:
      auditActor:
        testId: approval-audit-actor
      auditAction:
        testId: approval-audit-action
      auditResource:
        testId: approval-audit-resource
      creator:
        testId: approval-creator
      detailModal:
        testId: approval-detail-modal
      table:
        testId: approvals-table

  - pageId: operations.clearing
    routePattern: /clearing
    readyMarker:
      testId: clearing-panel
    elements:
      triggerBtn:
        testId: clearing-trigger-btn
        role: button
      batchId:
        testId: clearing-row-batch-id
      status:
        testId: clearing-row-status
      amount:
        testId: clearing-row-amount
      latestResult:
        testId: clearing-latest-result

- pageId: operations.reconciliation
    routePattern: /reconciliation
    readyMarker:
      testId: reconciliation-panel
    elements:
      batchType:
        testId: recon-row-batch-type
      status:
        testId: recon-row-status
      differenceCount:
        testId: recon-row-difference-count
      differenceAmount:
        testId: recon-row-difference-amount
      latestResult:
        testId: recon-latest-result

  - pageId: operations.eod
    routePattern: /eod
    readyMarker:
      testId: eod-panel
    elements:
      triggerBtn:
        testId: eod-trigger-btn
        role: button
      latestResult:
        testId: eod-latest-result
      latestStatus:
        testId: eod-latest-status
      businessDate:
        testId: eod-latest-business-date

  - pageId: operations.risk.alerts
    routePattern: /risk/alerts
    readyMarker:
      testId: risk-alerts-summary
    elements:
      alertId:
        testId: risk-alert-row-id
      severity:
        testId: risk-alert-row-severity
      status:
        testId: risk-alert-row-status
      rule:
        testId: risk-alert-row-rule
      total:
        testId: risk-alerts-total

  - pageId: operations.risk.cases
    routePattern: /risk/cases
    readyMarker:
      testId: risk-cases
    elements:
      caseId:
        testId: risk-row-id
      transferId:
        testId: risk-row-transfer-id
      decision:
        testId: risk-row-decision
      status:
        testId: risk-row-status
      score:
        testId: risk-row-score
      maker:
        testId: risk-row-maker
      checker:
        testId: risk-row-checker

- pageId: operations.documents
    routePattern: /documents
    readyMarker:
      testId: ops-documents
    elements:
      search:
        testId: doc-search
        role: textbox
      docId:
        testId: doc-row-id
      title:
        testId: doc-row-title
      category:
        testId: doc-row-category
      status:
        testId: doc-row-status

  - pageId: operations.audit
    routePattern: /audit
    readyMarker:
      testId: audit-row-timestamp
    elements:
      timestamp:
        testId: audit-row-timestamp
      eventType:
        testId: audit-row-event-type
      actorId:
        testId: audit-row-actor-id
      action:
        testId: audit-row-action
      resourceId:
        testId: audit-row-resource-id
      outcome:
        testId: audit-row-outcome
      recordHash:
        testId: audit-row-record-hash
      correlationId:
        testId: audit-row-correlation-id

  - pageId: operations.system-health
    routePattern: /system-health
    readyMarker:
      testId: system-health-metrics
    elements:
      alertId:
        testId: health-row-alert-id
      severity:
        testId: health-row-severity
      status:
        testId: health-row-status
      service:
        testId: health-row-service
      firingCount:
        testId: health-firing-count
